This notebook contains the final RDA panels used for Figure 2. Run it after
`publication_figures.Rmd` in the same R session because it reuses the imported
tables and objects created there.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(if (file.exists("../R/paths.R")) "../R/paths.R" else "R/paths.R")

dir.create("./Results/Figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


```{r, cache = TRUE}
ENV_field_nmaped_matrix <- ENV_field %>%
   dplyr::select(sample, sequence, n_mapped) %>%
    mutate(n_mapped = n_mapped + 1 ) %>%
  spread(sequence, n_mapped, fill = 1)
```


```{r, cache = TRUE}
ENV_field_nmaped_matrix_RenameSample <- ENV_field_nmaped_matrix %>%
    separate(sample, c("cruise", "day", "station", "reseq"), sep="_", remove=T) %>%
    unite(sample2, cruise, day, station, sep="_", remove=T) %>%
    dplyr::select (-reseq) %>%
    dplyr::rename (sample=sample2)
# ENV_field_codaseq_clr_MATRIX <- readRDS("ENV_field_codaseq_clr_MATRIX.rds")
```


```{r, cache = TRUE}
ENV_field_codaseq_clr_MATRIX <- ENV_field_nmaped_matrix_RenameSample %>%
  column_to_rownames('sample') %>%
  codaSeq.clr(samples.by.row = FALSE) %>% #calculate clr
  data.frame()
# saveRDS(ENV_field_codaseq_clr_MATRIX, file = "ENV_field_c odaseq_clr.rds")
```



```{r, cache = TRUE}
All_Pf_and_ENVmetadata_rda <- rda(ENV_field_codaseq_clr_MATRIX, Metadata_log)

#Hacemos una anova para saber cual de esas variables son significativas en funcion de nuestros datos
anova(All_Pf_and_ENVmetadata_rda) ### overall test of the significant of the analysis
anova(All_Pf_and_ENVmetadata_rda,by="terms",permutations = 999) #test for sign. environ. variables
```


```{r, cache = TRUE}
#Las variables significativas en este anÃ¡lisis son
dist_clbac<- vegdist(ENV_field_codaseq_clr_MATRIX, method="euclidean")
adonis(dist_clbac~., Metadata_log, method = "euclidean", by="terms")#PERmanova
```


```{r, cache = TRUE}
###Graficamos las variables significativas
All_Pf_and_ENVmetadata_rda_sig <- rda (ENV_field_codaseq_clr_MATRIX ~ # select the significant variables
                                        NO3+NH4+PO4+SiO2+Chlorophyll_a+Prokaryotic_abundance, Metadata_log)
```


```{r, cache = TRUE}

RDA_All_sequences_env <- ggord(All_Pf_and_ENVmetadata_rda_sig, env_flags_myrda$season_station,
      col = c("royalblue", # winter/coast
              "royalblue4", # winter/offshore
              "orangered", # spring/coast
              "orangered4", # spring/offshore
              "seagreen1", # summer/coast
              "seagreen4"), # summer/offshore
        labcol = 'black', # color of the labels
        veccol = 'snow4', # color of the vectors
        arrow = 0.5, # size of the vectors
        vec_ext = 0.5, # extension of the vectors......
        veclsz = 0.5, # size of the arrows
        vectyp = 'solid', # solid, dashed or dotted fo the arrow shape
        repel = T, # command to repel labels
        facet = F, nfac = 3, # facet command to separate the groups
        coord_fix = F, # ??
        grp_title = "Seasons") + # Name of the groups legend
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, size=16)) + # , face = "bold"
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size=16)) + # , face = "bold"
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=16))+ # , face = "bold"
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size=16))+ # , face = "bold"
        scale_color_manual(values = c( "royalblue", # winter/coast
                                "royalblue2",  # winter/offshore
                                "orangered", # spring/coast
                                "orangered2", # spring/offshore
                                "seagreen1",  # summer/coast
                                "seagreen2")) + # summer/offshore
        scale_shape_manual(values = c(19, 17, 19, 17, 19, 17)) + # coast=19, offshore=17
      xlim(c(-0.6,0.65)) +
      ylim(c(-1.2,0.50)) +
  labs(x = "RDA1 (43.32%)",
       y = "RDA2 (21.7%)") +
    theme(legend.direction = 'vertical', legend.position = 'none') + # Use "none" if you want to remove the legend
    # theme(legend.direction = 'horizontal', legend.position = 'bottom') + # "alternative legend position
    # labs( color="", size="", shape="") + #
  ggtitle("(B)")
RDA_All_sequences_env


ggsave("./Results/Figures/Figura_2A_RDA_AllProfiles_environmental.png",
       width = 17, # anchura
       height =8, # altura
       units = "cm",
       dpi = 300)
```


```{r, cache = TRUE}
Euk_ASVs_long <- pivot_longer(Euk_ASVs, cols=2:18, names_to = "order", values_to = "ASV")

Euk_ASVs_clr <- Euk_ASVs_long %>%
  # mutate(ASV = ASV + 1 ) %>%
  spread(order, ASV, fill = 0.5) %>%
  column_to_rownames('sample')%>%
  codaSeq.clr(samples.by.row = FALSE) %>% #calculate clr
  data.frame()



Bac_ASVs_long <- pivot_longer(Bac_ASVs, cols=2:16, names_to = "order", values_to = "ASV")

Bac_ASVs_clr<- Bac_ASVs_long %>%
  # mutate(ASV = ASV + 1 ) %>%
  spread(order, ASV, fill = 0.5) %>%
  column_to_rownames('sample')%>%
  codaSeq.clr(samples.by.row = FALSE) %>% #calculate clr
  data.frame()
```



```{r, cache = TRUE}
All_Pf_and_EukASVs_rda <- rda(ENV_field_codaseq_clr_MATRIX, Euk_ASVs_clr)

##Hacemos una anova para saber cual de esas variables son significativas en funcion de nuestros datos
anova(All_Pf_and_EukASVs_rda) ### overall test of the significant of the analysis
anova(All_Pf_and_EukASVs_rda, by="terms",permutations = 999) #test for sign. environ. variables
```


```{r, cache = TRUE}
#Las variables significativas en este anÃ¡lisis son
dist_clbac<- vegdist(ENV_field_codaseq_clr_MATRIX, method="euclidean")
adonis(dist_clbac ~., Euk_ASVs_clr, method = "euclidean", by="terms")#PERmanova
```


```{r, cache = TRUE}
###Graficamos las variables significativas
All_Pf_and_EukASVs_rda_sig <-rda(ENV_field_codaseq_clr_MATRIX ~ # select the significant variables
                                   Chaetoceros+
                                   Ciliophora+
                                   Cryptophyceae+
                                   Dictyochophyceae+
                                   Dinophyceae+
                                   Fungi, Euk_ASVs_clr)

```
